maddeler.e: اِتَّسَقَ • (ittasaqa) VIII (non-past يَتَّسِقُ (yattasiqu), verbal noun اِتِّسَاق (ittisāq))
maddeler.t: From وَسْق (wasq, “a measure of capacity as much as a camel can bear”), compare وَاسِقَ (wāsiqa, “to seek to measure oneself with, to be on par with”).
g: to harmonize, to be in line, to be consistent
to become full, to become loaded
